006package dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic;
007
008import java.net.URI;
009
010import dev.metaschema.core.datatype.adapter.MetaschemaDataTypeProvider;
011import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.InvalidValueForCastFunctionException;
012import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.impl.AnyUriItemImpl;
013import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.type.IAtomicOrUnionType;
014import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.type.InvalidTypeMetapathException;
015import dev.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
016import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
017
018/**
019 * An atomic Metapath item containing a URI data value.
020 */
021public interface IAnyUriItem extends IAnyAtomicItem {
022  /**
023   * Get the type information for this item.
024   *
025   * @return the type information
026   */
027  @NonNull
028  static IAtomicOrUnionType<IAnyUriItem> type() {
029    return MetaschemaDataTypeProvider.URI.getItemType();
030  }
031
032  @Override
033  default IAtomicOrUnionType<? extends IAnyUriItem> getType() {
034    return type();
035  }
036
037  /**
038   * Construct a new URI item using the provided string {@code value}.
039   *
040   * @param value
041   *          a string representing a URI
042   * @return the new item
043   * @throws InvalidTypeMetapathException
044   *           if the given string violates RFC2396
045   */
046  @NonNull
047  static IAnyUriItem valueOf(@NonNull String value) {
048    try {
049      return valueOf(MetaschemaDataTypeProvider.URI.parse(value));
050    } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {
051      throw new InvalidTypeMetapathException(
052          null,
053          String.format("Invalid URI value '%s'. %s",
054              value,
055              ex.getLocalizedMessage()),
056          ex);
057    }
058  }
059
060  /**
061   * Construct a new URI item using the provided URI {@code value}.
062   * <p>
063   * Example usage:
064   *
065   * <pre>
066   * URI uri = URI.create("http://example.com");
067   * IAnyUriItem item = IAnyUriItem.valueOf(uri);
068   * </pre>
069   *
070   * @param value
071   *          a URI
072   * @return the new item as a {@link IAnyUriItem} if the URI is absolute or
073   *         opaque, otherwise as an {@link IUriReferenceItem}
074   */
075  @NonNull
076  static IAnyUriItem valueOf(@NonNull URI value) {
077    IAnyUriItem retval;
078    if (value.isAbsolute() || value.isOpaque()) {
079      retval = new AnyUriItemImpl(value);
080    } else {
081      retval = IUriReferenceItem.valueOf(value);
082    }
083    return retval;
084  }
085
086  /**
087   * Cast the provided type to this item type.
088   *
089   * @param item
090   *          the item to cast
091   * @return the original item if it is already this type, otherwise a new item
092   *         cast to this type
093   * @throws InvalidValueForCastFunctionException
094   *           if the provided {@code item} cannot be cast to this type
095   */
096  @NonNull
097  static IAnyUriItem cast(@NonNull IAnyAtomicItem item) {
098    try {
099      return item instanceof IAnyUriItem
100          ? (IAnyUriItem) item
101          : valueOf(item.asString());
102    } catch (IllegalStateException | InvalidTypeMetapathException ex) {
103      // asString can throw IllegalStateException exception
104      throw new InvalidValueForCastFunctionException(ex);
105    }
106  }
107
108  @Override
109  default IAnyUriItem castAsType(IAnyAtomicItem item) {
110    return cast(item);
111  }
112
113  /**
114   * Get the "wrapped" URI value.
115   *
116   * @return the underlying URI value
117   */
118  @NonNull
119  URI asUri();
120
121  /**
122   * Determines if this URI has a scheme component, making it absolute.
123   *
124   * @return {@code true} if the URI is absolute, or {@code false} otherwise
125   */
126  default boolean isAbsolute() {
127    return asUri().isAbsolute();
128  }
129
130  /**
131   * Determines if this URI is opaque.
132   *
133   * @return {@code true} if the URI is opaque, or {@code false} otherwise
134   * @see URI#isOpaque()
135   */
136  default boolean isOpaque() {
137    return asUri().isOpaque();
138  }
139
140  /**
141   * Resolve the provided URI against this URI.
142   *
143   * @param other
144   *          the URI to resolve
145   * @return the resolved URI
146   * @see URI#resolve(URI)
147   */
148  @NonNull
149  default IAnyUriItem resolve(@NonNull IAnyUriItem other) {
150    return valueOf(ObjectUtils.notNull(asUri().resolve(other.asUri())));
151  }
152
153  /**
154   * Compares this value with the argument.
155   *
156   * @param item
157   *          the item to compare with this value
158   * @return a negative integer, zero, or a positive integer if this value is less
159   *         than, equal to, or greater than the {@code item}.
160   */
161  default int compareTo(@NonNull IAnyUriItem item) {
162    return asUri().compareTo(item.asUri());
163  }
164}
